## Checklist

- [ ] `actionlint` passes locally
- [ ] Any new third-party action is pinned to a full commit SHA with a `# vX.Y.Z` comment
- [ ] New jobs start from `permissions: {}` and grant only what they need
- [ ] Every new input and secret is documented in the README
- [ ] No hardcoded hostnames, project IDs, account numbers, or credentials
- [ ] I checked that no log output or example pasted here contains a real secret
